page_title: ATM 1-0 GET | Atletico Madrid v Getafe 15/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' Koke (Atl. Madrid) sees a yellow card from Cesar Soto after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

90+1' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance! The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' A yellow card for a tackle by Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid). Cesar Soto doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
87' Peter Federico (Getafe) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
86' Here comes a substitution. Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) is brought on as a substitute for Pablo Barrios.
83' David Soria displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Koke (Atl. Madrid) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
82' Christantus Uche (Getafe) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Cesar Soto no option but to blow his whistle.
81' Corner kicks – 8:3.
77' Jose Bordalas Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Omar Alderete will be replaced by Juan Berrocal Gonzalez (Getafe).
77' Jose Bordalas Jimenez prepares a substitution. Alvaro Rodriguez is replaced by Peter Federico (Getafe).
77' Substitution. Coba Gomez da Costa will be replaced by Bertug Yildirim (Getafe).
76' A quickly taken corner by Atl. Madrid.
72' Today's referee Cesar Soto rightly decides to book Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) for his harsh tackle.
69' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) attempts to discuss the decision with Cesar Soto, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
69' 1 - 0 Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low inside the right post. Excellent finish.
68' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
65' Atl. Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
63' Antoine Griezmann goes off the pitch and Koke (Atl. Madrid) comes on.
61' Getafe take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
61' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Getafe. Getafe force a corner. They send men into the box.
59' David Soria displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
56' The referee allows time for a substitution. Marcos Llorente will be replaced by Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid).
56' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a change. Alex Sola (Getafe) replaces Yellu Santiago.
55' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Christantus Uche (Getafe) is coming onto the pitch as Abdoulaye Keita cannot continue after picking up an injury.
55' The substitution is prepared. Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Giuliano Simeone.
53' 9:3 – the total goal attempt statistics.
50' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
46' Diego Simeone makes a half-time substitution. Alexander Sorloth comes on in place of Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Yellu Santiago (Getafe) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
45+3' The resulting set piece from Atl. Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+2' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) makes a strong challenge and Cesar Soto blows for a foul.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

44' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) in a great chance! He climbs highest deep in the penalty box and strikes with a powerful header towards the net. Next time he should aim better. His effort ends wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
42' David Soria blocks Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid)'s effort from the edge of the box.
41' The possession of the ball – 59:41.
35' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
31' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
31' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
30' Abdoulaye Keita (Getafe) gathers the pass and without hesitation smashes a shot in from long range, but it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
29' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
28' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
23' Getafe take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

23' Abdoulaye Keita (Getafe) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Getafe have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
20' The current number of corner kicks is 5:0.

18' The cross fools the defence and leaves Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
17' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
14' The corner from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is cleared away by the defence.

14' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
11' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman signals a throw-in for Atl. Madrid.
9' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
8' Cesar Soto blows for a foul after Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
6' Flag up against Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
4' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
3' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
3' Atl. Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Corner kick. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity.
2' Yellu Santiago (Getafe) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Getafe will kick the game off.
Cesar Soto will supervise the game today.
